blurb: Guests can enjoy craft beer brewed on site, NW hard cider, WA wine, and small plates in a family and dog-friendly taproom with arcade games and outdoor patio. The brewery offers keg rentals, growlers, crowlers, and cans for take-home. Private event space and weekly/monthly events are available.
